items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: And when I came in Dave's band, it was two tenors and alto trumpet.

ctx.x: And how did you get into Today?

Through Earl Palmer. He was with the Today Bartholomew's band. And when I joined the band, Frank Fields was in the band. Ernest McLean was in the band. Earl Palmer was in the band. Older gentleman by the name of Clarence Hall was playing tenor saxophone. And Joe Harris was playing alto. I'm trying to think of, there's a guy called P. Lou was playing piano. I'm not what his real name was. But that was the nickname, P. Lou. P. Lou. Yeah. Earl Palmer would probably, Dave would know what his real name was. And when I…
Were you taking somebody's place? No. Somebody had been with the band? No. Okay. So tell me about Dave Bartholomew when you first joined the band.
